Blood Guard Unit

Preliminary 3D concept of an add-on that sits inside an existing blood-bank fridge (1–6 °C) and watches up to five red-cell or whole-blood units. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, click any part to read what it is and what its colour means.

Loading model…
Drag: orbit · Right-drag: pan · Click: select
Two separate paths. Safety path: temperature probes → independent safety MCU → alarm. It never passes through the AI. Intelligence path: cameras → compute module → flags for the technician. The system raises flags and the technician decides; it is not a diagnostic device.

Preliminary concept, not a medical device. A final product needs SFDA registration, electrical-safety and EMC testing, and calibration records. Storage range 1–6 °C; bags must never touch cold walls or be squeezed.
